srs.title: Core Banking Ledger System for V-CIP Onboarding and RBI Compliance (₹50k Limit)
srs.summary: The system shall serve as the Core Banking Ledger for a bank, managing deposits, withdrawals, and interest postings. It must support full V-CIP (Virtual Customer Identification Process) onboarding for walk-in customers, including assisted sessions via Business Correspondents (BCs), while strictly en
assumptions: The bank will have access to an external KYC/AML API or equivalent verification facility to validate PAN and address in real-time.
The bank currently possesses the necessary V-CIP infrastructure (video capture, audit recording, cybersecurity) as per RBI baseline standards.
The bank has a defined process for obtaining the 'First Transaction' as a credit from an existing KYC-compliant account.
stakeholders: Bank Operations/Branch Staff: Responsible for initiating walk-in CDD and orchestrating V-CIP sessions.
Business Correspondents (BCs): Assist walk-in customers during V-CIP (ultimate responsibility remains with the bank).
Compliance/Audit Team: Responsible for concurrent audit sign-off and regulatory reporting.
Customers (Walk-in & Account-based): Users of the onboarding and transaction processes.
RBI/Regulator: External body setting the compliance rules (₹50k threshold, V-CIP standards).
System Administrator: Manages user access, configuration, and system health.

requirements.statement: The system shall restrict transaction validation to amounts of ₹50,000 or below unless specific high-value conditions are met per RBI guidelines.
requirements.acceptance: All transactions below ₹50,000 are processed automatically; transactions ≥ ₹50,000 are blocked unless paired with verified PAN and specific debit methods.

requirements.statement: For V-CIP onboarding, the system shall automatically capture a clear image of the customer's PAN card.
requirements.acceptance: The system generates and stores a clear image of the PAN card for all walk-in assisted V-CIP customers, except where e-PAN is provided.

requirements.statement: The system shall verify PAN details against the issuing authority's database and/or DigiLocker integration.
requirements.acceptance: PAN verification fails and onboarding stops if details do not match the issuing authority database or DigiLocker.

requirements.statement: The system shall reject V-CIP submissions if a printed copy of an e-document (including e-PAN) is provided instead of a digital e-PAN.
requirements.acceptance: V-CIP process halts and an error is logged if the submitted PAN document is a physical printed copy of an e-document.

requirements.statement: The system shall verify that the photograph in the Aadhaar/OVD matches the live customer photo and that identification details match across all documents.
requirements.acceptance: V-CIP process halts if facial recognition comparison between Aadhaar/OVD and live capture fails or if name/address mismatches are detected.

requirements.statement: The system shall enforce end-to-end encryption for all data transmitted during the V-CIP process.
requirements.acceptance: All data streams (video, document uploads) are encrypted using approved standards (e.g., TLS 1.3), and logs confirm encryption keys are not exposed.

requirements.statement: The system shall enforce a 'bring your own device' policy where all video recordings and data are stored exclusively on the bank's own servers post-processing.
requirements.acceptance: System logs confirm data transfer to on-premise/leased servers immediately after V-CIP completion; no data is retained by third-party cloud providers.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow the registration of only the mobile number used for account opening for OTPs and transaction alerts post-CDD.
requirements.acceptance: System rejects attempts to link alternate mobile numbers for OTPs in V-CIP accounts; only the registered number at account opening is accepted.

requirements.statement: The system shall require positive verification of the customer's current address via document (e.g., address proof) or live verification before allowing account operations.
requirements.acceptance: Account remains in 'Inoperative' status until the system receives and validates a positive address confirmation (e.g., AML address verification service).
